Median dry-season NDVI and NDMI composite from Landsat scenes

Source: R/landsat.R
landsat_composite.Rd

Reads only the window around aoi from each scene's cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs, masks cloud, shadow, snow and water with qa_clear(), converts to surface reflectance, and takes the per-pixel median over all clear observations.

Usage

landsat_composite(scenes, aoi, buffer_m = 100)

Arguments

scenes

Output of landsat_scenes().

aoi

sf/sfc area to read (any CRS), normally the corridor.

buffer_m

Extra margin read around aoi, in metres.

Value

A SpatRaster on the Landsat 30 m grid (UTM) with layers ndvi, ndmi and n_obs (clear observations per pixel). Attributes scenes (ids used) and dates record what went into it.

Details

  • NDVI = (NIR - red) / (NIR + red): greenness / live leaf area.

  • NDMI = (NIR - SWIR1) / (NIR + SWIR1): canopy water content, the closer of the two to fuel moisture.

Both are relative indicators. They are not fuel-moisture measurements and have no fire-danger thresholds; compare pixels within one composite, not across sites or seasons.
